newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-McIntosh seeks trading halt on stock.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-McIntosh seeks trading halt on stock.

text.p: Brokerage firm McIntosh Securities Ltd said on Monday it had requested a trading halt on its shares pending release of an announcement to the Australian Stock Exchange.
The company has said recently it had no comment on market rumours that it would soon agree to a friendly takeover bid by Merrill Lynch.
McIntosh is 20 percent owned by the Netherland's Ing Bank.
Media reports over the weekend said the takeover would be announced before the firm's annual general meeting in Melbourne late on Tuesday afternoon.
McIntosh shares rose sharply last week with the rumour pushing the stock to a A$1.25 close on Friday compared with A$1.06 on Thursday morning when the takeover talk first emerged.
McIntosh shares were untraded on Monday.
